name: Owain Rhys
bio: Owain's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in rural Wales, where he spent countless hours tinkering with engines alongside his father, a local mechanic. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering and quickly found his way into the world of racing, initially as a junior engineer for a Formula 3 team. His meticulous approach and keen eye for detail saw him rise through the ranks, eventually leading technical teams in various racing series. Owain believes in fostering a collaborative environment where innovation is encouraged, and data-driven decisions are paramount. His visionary leadership style has earned him a reputation for consistently pushing the boundaries of performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height with a thoughtful expression etched on his face.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out notebook filled with technical sketches.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
Insists on using metric units for everything, even when dealing with colleagues from other countries.
